basic_info.description: Beautiful residence at the prestigious 101 Lombard complex. 101 Lombard Street #402W features a large, light-filled living area with beautiful wood flooring, wall-to-wall windows, and balcony access and dry bar. A dedicated formal dining area.  Adjacent to the dining area is a well-designed kitchen with modern countertops, a Danby wine fridge, and a premium Bosch appliance package. The spacious primary bedroom suite features two closets, including a separate walk-in closet and an en-suite bath and balcony. The guest bedroom has excellent light via two oversized windows and a walk-in closet. A convenient full bath is in the hall next to the guest room. Completing the home is a full washer and dryer in the kitchen closet, a 1-car deeded garage parking space near the elevator, and additional storage on the same floor. There is a secure bike room and EV charging station, swimming pool and spa, a 24-hour security doorman, an expansive view roof deck, and a car-washing area.
